verdict.rationale: No retention or deletion controls are documented. The only support is indirect: self-hosted Skyvern runs entirely on your own servers, browsers and LLM keys, so run artifacts stay on infrastructure you control. The docs also confirm every run automatically captures recordings, screenshots, reasoning and network traffic, which is exactly the data a user would want to govern. missing for 10: documented retention policies or configurable retention windows, API/UI deletion of runs and artifacts, cloud-tier data deletion guarantees, independent corroboration.
